Update installed
Open Shasha again to run the new version.
Installing updates isn\'t allowed yet
Give Shasha permission to install apps, once, from a computer on the same network as the TV (running the installer again does it, as in the Shasha Guide), then press “Try again”:
Checking for updates needs a read token
Shasha\'s GitHub repository is private: reading its releases needs a read-only token in the UPDATE_TOKEN secret at build time (see the Shasha Guide). This version was built without one.
Or download the latest APK on a computer and install it over this version with the installer or ADB:

Couldn\'t reach GitHub
Make sure the TV is connected to the internet, then try again.
The read token was refused

GitHub refused the read token this version was built with: it expired or was revoked. Renew it, put it in the UPDATE_TOKEN secret, then install the next version by running the installer again, as in the Shasha Guide.
GitHub refused the request
Either too many requests were made (wait a little, then try again), or the read token isn\'t allowed to read the repository.
No published version found
There\'s no version on GitHub Releases yet, or the read token can\'t reach Shasha\'s repository.
The latest version has no install file
The latest published version has no APK file. Wait for the next one, or install with ADB.
The version name isn\'t understood
The latest release tag doesn\'t match the form the build publishes: v<version>-<build number>.
Unexpected answer from GitHub
GitHub\'s answer wasn\'t understood. Try again in a little while.
The download stopped
The file couldn\'t be downloaded in full. Try again.
The file isn\'t a valid app
The system couldn\'t read the downloaded file, so it wasn\'t installed.
The file is for another app
The downloaded file isn\'t Shasha, so it wasn\'t installed.
The file isn\'t newer than the installed version
The downloaded file\'s build number isn\'t higher than the installed one, so it wasn\'t installed.
Different signing key

This file is signed with a key other than the installed Shasha\'s, so it was refused. The signing key must never change: Android won\'t install an update signed with another key over the current version.
The installation didn\'t finish
The TV\'s system refused to install. Details below; try again, or install with ADB.
Updates are in the adult profile
Checking for and installing updates is done from the adult profile\'s settings. Ask a parent.
